content: Isireli be Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u yoru mwɛɛrɑ u kɑ dɑ Bɑbiloniɔ ben dɑbirɑ wurɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ Yudɑɔ mɑ ben bɑɑwure u dɑ u sinɑ win wuuɔ.

Tɔn be bɑ bu kpɑre bɑ kɑ wurɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ mi, berɑ Sorobɑbɛli kɑ Yosue kɑ Nɛɛmi kɑ Serɑyɑ kɑ Relɑyɑ kɑ Mɑɑdose kɑ Bilisɑni kɑ Misipɑɑ kɑ Biɡifɑi kɑ Rehumu kɑ Bɑɑnɑ. Isireli be kpuron ɡeeru wee bwese kɛrɑ kɑ bwese kɛrɑ.
Pɑreɔsin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (2.172).
Sefɑtiɑn bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (372).
Arɑsin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu (775).
Pɑrɑti Mɔɑbun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ nɛnɛ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (2.812). Tɔn be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yoɑbu kɑ Yosuen sikɑdominu.
Elɑmun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nnɛ (1.254).
Sɑtun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɛnɛ kɑ wunɔbu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (945).
Sɑkɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ (760).
Bɑnin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ weeru kɑ yiru (642).
Bebɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ yɛndɑ itɑ (623).
Asiɡɑdin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ yɛndɑ yiru (1.222).
Adonikɑmun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wɑtɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ (666).
Biɡifɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ (2.056).
Adinin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɛɛru kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nnɛ (454).
Atɛɛn bweseru sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Esekiɑsin yɛnuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɔbu yiru sɑri.
Bɛsɑin bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ yɛndɑ itɑ (323).
Yorɑn bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɔbu kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (112).
Hɑsun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobu kɑ yɛndɑ itɑ (223).
Gibɑɑn bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɛnɛ kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu.
Bɛtelehɛmuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ itɑ (123).
Nɛtofɑɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu weerɑɑkuru kɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ.
Anɑtɔtuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (128).
Asimɑfɛtiɡibu, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu weeru kɑ yiru.
Kiriɑti Arimuɡibu kɑ Kefirɑɡibu kɑ Beerɔtuɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɔbu kɑ weeru kɑ itɑ (743).
Rɑmɑɡibu kɑ Gebɑɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ yɛndɑ tiɑ (621).
Mikimɑsiɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ yiru (122).
Betɛliɡibu kɑ Ayiɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobu kɑ yɛndɑ itɑ (223).
Nɛboɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu weerɑɑkuru kɑ yiru.
Mɑɡibisiɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ weeru kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ (156).
Elɑmu ɡoon bweseru sɔɔ mɑɑ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ nnɛ (1.254).
Hɑrimun bibun bweseru sɔɔ, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ yɛndu (320).
Loduɡibu kɑ Hɑdidiɡibu kɑ Onɔɔɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru kɑ nɔɔbu (725).
Yerikoɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (345).
Senɑɑɡibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ kɑ nɑtɑ kɑ tɛnɑ (3.630).
Yɑ̃ku kowobu Lefibɑn bweseru sɔɔ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yedɑyɑn bibu be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yosuen yɛnuɡibu, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɛnɛ kɑ wunɑɑ wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ itɑ (973).
Imɛrin bibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ yiru (1.052).
Pɑsurin bibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ ɡoobu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (1.247).
Hɑrimun bibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbu kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yiru (1.017).
Lefibɑ sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yosue kɑ Kɑdimiɛli, Hodɑfiɑn sikɑdominu, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wɑtɑ kɑ wɔkurɑ nnɛ (74).
Lefi be sɔɔ, be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ wom kowobu Asɑfun sikɑdominu bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ nɔɔbɑ itɑ (128).
Lefi be sɔɔ, be bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun kɔnnɔsu kɔ̃su, berɑ Sɑlumun debuminu kɑ Atɛɛ kɑ Tɑlumɔɔ kɑ Akubu kɑ Hɑtitɑ kɑ Sobɑi. Be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu wunɑɑ teeru kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ nnɛ (139).
Be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Nɛtinin bweseru sɔɔ, ben sikɑdobɑrɑ Sisɑ, kɑ Hɑsufɑ kɑ Tɑbɑɔtu
kɑ Kɛrɔsi kɑ Siɑɑ kɑ Pɑdoni
kɑ Lebɑnɑ kɑ Hɑɡɑbɑ kɑ Akubu
kɑ Hɑɡɑbu kɑ Sɑmulɑi kɑ Hɑnɑnu
kɑ Gidɛli kɑ Gɑsɑrɑ kɑ Reɑyɑ
kɑ Resini kɑ Nɛkodɑ kɑ Gɑsɑmu
kɑ Usɑ kɑ Pɑseɑki kɑ Besɑi
kɑ Asinɑ kɑ Mɛhunimu kɑ Nɛfusimu
kɑ Bɑkibuki kɑ Hɑkufɑ kɑ Hɑɑhuru
kɑ Bɑsilutu kɑ Mɛhidɑ kɑ Hɑɑsɑ
kɑ Bɑɑkɔsi kɑ Siserɑ kɑ Tɑmɑɑ
kɑ Nɛtisɑ kɑ Hɑtifɑ.
Be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Sɑlomɔɔn sɔm kowobun bibun sikɑdobɑ, berɑ Sotɑi kɑ Soferɛti kɑ Perudɑ
kɑ Yɑɑlɑ kɑ Dɑɑkoni kɑ Gidɛli
kɑ Sefɑtiɑ kɑ Hɑtili kɑ Pokerɛti Hɑtisebɑimu kɑ Ami.
Sɑlomɔɔn sɔm kowo ben bibu kɑ Nɛtini be, be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɛnɛ kɑ wɔkurɑ yiru (392).

Tɔmbu nɑtɑ kɑ weerɑɑkuru kɑ yiru (652) be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Delɑyɑ kɑ Tobiyɑ kɑ Nɛkodɑn bweseru bɑ wurɑmɑ Tɛli Mɛlɑn di kɑ Tɛli Asɑn di kɑ Kerubu Adɑnin di kɑ Imɛrin di bɑ ǹ kpĩɑ bɑ ben bweserun tɔ̃kɑ wunɑnɛ bu kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ ben tii bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Isirelibɑ.

Yɑ̃ku kowobu sɔɔ, ɡɑbɑ ben bweserun tɔ̃kɑ kɑsu bɑ biɑ, mɑ bɑ bu yɑrɑ yɑ̃ku sɔmburun di. Berɑ, Hɑbɑyɑn bweseru kɑ Hɑkɔtuɡiru kɑ Bɑɑsilɑiɡiru. Bɑ bwese te sokɑ Bɑɑsilɑi yèn sɔ̃ ben sikɑdo u Bɑɑsilɑi Gɑlɑdiɡiin bii wɔndiɑ suɑ kurɔ.
Mɑ tem mɛn kpɑro u nɛɛ, mɑ n kun mɔ yɑ̃ku kowo ɡoo u kpĩɑ u bikiɑru kuɑ kɑ urimu kɑ tumimu, ben ɡoo kun yɑ̃ku dĩɑnu dimɔ.
Tɔn be kpuro bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ weeru kɑ yiru kɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ wɑtɑ (42.360).
Ben sɔm kowobun ɡeeru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑ ɡoobɑ wunɔbu kɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (7.337). Be sɔɔ, wom kowobɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡoobu (200) tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu.
Bɑ dumi mɔwɑ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru kɑ wɔkurɑ nɔɔbu kɑ tiɑ (736) kɑ birɑkɔsu ɡoobu kɑ weeru kɑ nɔɔbu (245)
kɑ mɑɑ yooyoosu nɛɛru kɑ tɛnɑ kɑ nɔɔbu (435) kɑ kɛtɛkunu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ tiɑ kɑ nɑtɑ kɑ wunɑɑ teeru (6.720).
Ye Isirelibɑ bɑ turɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, yerɑ yɛnu yɛ̃robu ɡɑbu bɑ kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ kɛ̃ru nɑɑwɑ bu kɑ win sɑ̃ɑ yeru bɑni mi tɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ.

Bɑɑwure u win kɛ̃ru wɛ̃wɑ nɡe mɛ win mɔrɑ nɛ sɑ̃ɑ yee ten sɔmburun sɔ̃. Kɛ̃ɛ ni kpuro nu kuɑ wurɑn ɡobi nɔrɔbun subɑ wɑtɑ kɑ tiɑ (61.000) kɑ sii ɡeesun kilo nɔrɔbun subɑ yiru kɑ nɛɛrɑ wunɔbu (2.500) kɑ yɑ̃ku kowon tɑkobɑ wunɔbu (100).
Yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑ kɑ Isireli be bɑ tie kɑ wom kowobu kɑ be bɑ rɑ kɔnnɔsu kɔ̃su kɑ Nɛtinibɑ, be kpuro bɑ sinɑwɑ ben wusɔ mi bɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ, Isirelibɑ kpuro ɡesi.
Yosue kɑ Sorobɑbɛli
bɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑru seeyɑ
